DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.int_dvd_pow_sub_pow_iff_primeOrder_dvd
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem int_dvd_pow_sub_pow_iff_primeOrder_dvd {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]
    (a b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hb : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ b) :
    (q : ℤ) ∣ a ^ n - b ^ n ↔ primeOrder q a b ∣ n

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_dvd_pow_sub_pow_iff_primeOrder_dvd
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem nat_dvd_pow_sub_pow_iff_primeOrder_dvd {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]
    (a b n : ℕ) (hab : b ≤ a) (hb : ¬ q ∣ b) :
    q ∣ a ^ n - b ^ n ↔ primeOrder q a b ∣ n

theorem primeOrder_dvd_prime_sub_one {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] {a b : ℤ}

    (ha : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ a) (hb : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ b) : 0 < primeOrder q a b

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.isRoot_cyclotomic_iff_prime_pow_mul_orderOf
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem isRoot_cyclotomic_iff_prime_pow_mul_orderOf
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {q : ℕ} [hq : Fact q.Prime]
    [CharP R q] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (z : R) :
    (cyclotomic n R).IsRoot z ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, n = orderOf z * q ^ k

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.isRoot_cyclotomic_iff_orderOf_of_not_dvd
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem isRoot_cyclotomic_iff_orderOf_of_not_dvd
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]
    [CharP R q] {n : ℕ} (hqn : ¬q ∣ n) (z : R) :
    (cyclotomic n R).IsRoot z ↔ orderOf z = n

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.isRoot_cyclotomic_mul_prime_iff
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem isRoot_cyclotomic_mul_prime_iff
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {q : ℕ} [hq : Fact q.Prime]
    [CharP R q] (n : ℕ) (z : R) :
    (cyclotomic (n * q) R).IsRoot z ↔ (cyclotomic n R).IsRoot z

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.isRoot_cyclotomic_mul_prime_pow_iff
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem isRoot_cyclotomic_mul_prime_pow_iff
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]
    [CharP R q] (n k : ℕ) (z : R) :
    (cyclotomic (n * q ^ k) R).IsRoot z ↔ (cyclotomic n R).IsRoot z

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_iff_isRoot
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_iff_isRoot
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    (q : ℤ) ∣ DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.cyclotomicEval n a ↔
      (cyclotomic n (ZMod q)).IsRoot (a : ZMod q)

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_iff_prime_pow_mul_orderOf
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_iff_prime_pow_mul_orderOf
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : ℤ) :
    (q : ℤ) ∣ DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.cyclotomicEval n a ↔
      ∃ k : ℕ, n = orderOf (a : ZMod q) * q ^ k

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_iff_orderOf_of_not_dvd
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_iff_orderOf_of_not_dvd
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] {n : ℕ} (hqn : ¬q ∣ n) (a : ℤ) :
    (q : ℤ) ∣ DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.cyclotomicEval n a ↔
      orderOf (a : ZMod q) = n

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_mul_prime_pow_iff
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem prime_dvd_cyclotomicEval_mul_prime_pow_iff
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (n k : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    (q : ℤ) ∣ DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.cyclotomicEval (n * q ^ k) a ↔
      (q : ℤ) ∣ DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.cyclotomicEval n a

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.padicValInt_cyclotomicEval_eq_pow_sub_one_of_orderOf_eq
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem padicValInt_cyclotomicEval_eq_pow_sub_one_of_orderOf_eq
    {q n : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (a : ℤ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (horder : orderOf (a : ZMod q) = n) (hdiff : a ^ n - 1 ≠ 0) :
    padicValInt q (cyclotomicEval n a) = padicValInt q (a ^ n - 1)

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.padicValNat_pow_sub_pow_mul_prime_pow
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_pow_sub_pow_mul_prime_pow
    {q a b r : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hqodd : Odd q) (hab : b < a)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hqar : ¬ q ∣ a) (hqdiff : q ∣ a ^ r - b ^ r) (k : ℕ) :
    padicValNat q (a ^ (r * q ^ k) - b ^ (r * q ^ k)) =
      padicValNat q (a ^ r - b ^ r) + k

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.padicValNat_pow_sub_pow_mul_two_pow_succ
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_pow_sub_pow_mul_two_pow_succ
    {a b r : ℕ} (hab : b < a) (hr : r ≠ 0) (haodd : ¬ 2 ∣ a)
    (hdiff : 2 ∣ a ^ r - b ^ r) (k : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 2 (a ^ (r * 2 ^ (k + 1)) - b ^ (r * 2 ^ (k + 1))) =
      padicValNat 2 (a ^ r + b ^ r) + padicValNat 2 (a ^ r - b ^ r) + k

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.natAbs_cyclotomicEval_prime_pow
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem natAbs_cyclotomicEval_prime_pow (q a k : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) :
    (cyclotomicEval (q ^ (k + 1)) (a : ℤ)).natAbs =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range q, (a ^ (q ^ k)) ^ i

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.natAbs_cyclotomicEval_prime_pow_mul_sub_one
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem natAbs_cyclotomicEval_prime_pow_mul_sub_one
    (q a k : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) (ha : 1 < a) :
    (cyclotomicEval (q ^ (k + 1)) (a : ℤ)).natAbs * (a ^ (q ^ k) - 1) =
      a ^ (q ^ (k + 1)) - 1

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.padicValNat_cyclotomicEval_prime_pow_eq_one
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_cyclotomicEval_prime_pow_eq_one
    {q a : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hqodd : Odd q) (ha : 1 < a)
    (hqa : ¬ q ∣ a) (hqdiff : q ∣ a - 1) (k : ℕ) :
    padicValNat q (cyclotomicEval (q ^ (k + 1)) (a : ℤ)).natAbs = 1

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.padicValNat_cyclotomicEval_two
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_cyclotomicEval_two (a : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 2 (cyclotomicEval 2 (a : ℤ)).natAbs = padicValNat 2 (a + 1)

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.padicValNat_cyclotomicEval_two_pow_succ_eq_one
promoted_declarations.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_cyclotomicEval_two_pow_succ_eq_one
    {a : ℕ} (ha : 1 < a) (haodd : ¬ 2 ∣ a) (hdiff : 2 ∣ a - 1) (k : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 2 (cyclotomicEval (2 ^ (k + 2)) (a : ℤ)).natAbs = 1

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.primeOrder_eq_one_iff_dvd_gap
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem primeOrder_eq_one_iff_dvd_gap {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]
    (a b : ℤ) (hb : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ b) :
    primeOrder q a b = 1 ↔ (q : ℤ) ∣ a - b

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.int_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_primeOrder_dvd_of_gap
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem int_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_primeOrder_dvd_of_gap
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (a b : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (hb : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ b) (hgap : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ a - b) :
    (q : ℤ) ∣ powerDifferenceCofactor n a b ↔ primeOrder q a b ∣ n

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.int_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_primeOrder_dvd
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem int_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_primeOrder_dvd

    (hb : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ b) (hr : 1 < primeOrder q a b) :
    (q : ℤ) ∣ powerDifferenceCofactor n a b ↔ primeOrder q a b ∣ n

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.nat_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_primeOrder_dvd
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem nat_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_primeOrder_dvd
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (a b n : ℕ) (hb : ¬ q ∣ b)
    (hr : 1 < primeOrder q a b) :
    q ∣ powerDifferenceCofactor n a b ↔ primeOrder q a b ∣ n

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.nat_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_dvd_index_of_order_one
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem nat_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_iff_dvd_index_of_order_one
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (a b n : ℕ) (hb : ¬ q ∣ b)
    (hr : primeOrder q a b = 1) :
    q ∣ powerDifferenceCofactor n a b ↔ q ∣ n
